system.description:
Trained by no single circle: an itinerant tradition passed between solitary druids, hermits and wandering teachers, beholden to no Hierophant: solitary druids on the borders of Ordenvael and Tariel.

  • Wayfarer's Form: your Wild Shape lasts up to 8 hours when you take a form to travel, and ends early if you attack or cast a spell.
    • 9th level, Wild Instinct: you can shift as part of your movement.
  • Horizon Reader: Advantage on Nature Lore checks in any kind of country after a full day in it, even one that is not yours.
